text:
maria: Quick thread — proposal to unify the rerank endpoint output so downstreams can unambiguously compute billing and display scores in the console. Thinking: single envelope with version, per-candidate score, normalized_score, model_id, and unit_count.
aj: +1 on a single envelope, otherwise every client reimplements heuristics. do you have a sample shape? :thinking:
maria: Example draft: ```json
{
  "envelope_version": "1",
  "model_id": "rerank-v2",
  "candidates": [
    {"id": "c1", "raw_score": 6.2, "normalized_score": 0.89, "units": 1},
    {"id": "c2", "raw_score": 2.3, "normalized_score": 0.33, "units": 1}
  ],
  "meta": {"fanout": 3, "kv_cache_hit": false}
}
```
kevin: Two quick asks: 1) how do we define normalized_score (per-request min/max? softmax?) 2) units — is that per-candidate token-ish, or a billing abstraction?
sara: For normalized_score we should provide both a deterministic transform (e.g., rescaled min-max across candidates) and an opencalc hint like "scale=softmax" so caller understands. Otherwise dashboards will be inconsistent.
maria: Agreed. Plan: include raw_score, normalized_score, and norm_method in meta. norm_method tries to capture how normalized_score was produced. units will be the accounting units we use for quota; for now 1 candidate = 1 unit unless heavy context required. That keeps quota predictable.
aj: Sounds reasonable. Concern: multi-model fanout — if we call 3 models per request, do we bill 3 units per candidate? or 3*units? ops wants clarity.
kevin: We bill by evaluated candidate per model. So 10 candidates x 3 models = 30 scoring-units. Need that surfaced to console and in telemetry. Otherwise customers see mismatched cost vs UI.
sara: UX note — console should show both "apparent candidates" (post-merge) and "scoring units consumed" so PMs can relate cost to results. Also a dropdown to show model affinity per-candidate for canary.
maria: Implementation notes: runtime will attach header X-Rerank-Envelope-Version and keep envelope in body. Backcompat: if client passes accept=application/vnd.rerank.v1+json we return legacy shape. Otherwise default to new envelope.
aj: Nice. For rollout, recommend canary by header + console flag so we can flip per-customer. We should also add a telemetry tag envelope_version and model_fanout to traces.
kevin: Telemetry: sample event schema? ops-bot can we add an event `rerank.score_executed` with fields: env_v, model_ids[], candidate_count, scoring_units, norm_method?
ops-bot: noted. I created ticket INF-4287 and a baseline event in prod telemetry pipeline: rerank.score_executed { env_v, models, candidates, scoring_units, norm_method, kv_cache_rate }.
sara: Dashboard tweak: quota tile should show daily scoring_units used and a breakdown by model. Also make routing policy visible: e.g., if fallback happened to cheaper model, show a little badge.
maria: Routing/quotas debate: if fallback reduces model fidelity, do we still charge original model units? my take: charge actual model executed. If caller explicitly pinned model then no fallback billing allowed (fail instead).
aj: Agreed — pinned means fail or degrade with explicit error. For route-by-cost policies we should surface which policy triggered fallback in metadata.
kevin: Edge case: cached prefixes that skip scoring for some candidates — units should reflect work done (0 for fully skipped, partial for partial scoring). Need KV cache telemetry to justify billing reductions.
maria: Good call. meta.kv_cache_hit per candidate and aggregate kv_cache_rate at top-level. We'll use that to compute billed_units.
sara: API contract doc needs a small example for frontend: how to render scores and what to display for model fallbacks. I'll mock a console panel.
aj: One more: add deprecation path — envelope_version=1 now, plan to move clients over in 6 months, add server header Warning when returning v1.
maria: I'll draft the PR: runtime change + schema + telemetry events + console UX mocks. Tagging kevin and sara for review.
kevin: If you add a small compat test that hits both legacy and new acceptance headers, I can review the infra pieces.
sara: I'll do console mocks + small copy for UX team. :shipit:
maria: Thanks — filing the RFC and attaching PR link when ready.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: rerank-runtime/v1.12 -> canary at cluster-c, started 1742500100

maria: cool, will update thread with PR and docs when ready.
aj: thanks all.
